purpose: Freeze one point-in-time operating-leverage factor, a complete 89-definition no-return screen, and one conditional development trial before reading any Campaign058 source row or value.

candidate.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_growth_spread_pp
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Profit growth outrunning revenue growth is a point-in-time operating-leverage or margin-expansion proxy that may remain relevant through a three-session holding horizon.
candidate.availability_semantics: Map announcement_date to the first accepted local session strictly after it. Sort by instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date; keep the last row per instrument and effective session. Forward-fill revenue_yoy and profit_yoy independently inside each instrument, never backward or across instruments.
candidate.value_semantics: Subtract the finite already-effective revenue_yoy state from the finite already-effective profit_yoy state without rank, ratio, log, clipping, winsorization, standardization, scaling, threshold, or imputation.
candidate.missing_semantics: A stock-day with no finite already-effective state for either field remains missing. Later reports never backfill earlier stock-days and another issuer never supplies a value.

coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.coverage_basis: candidate finite rows divided by quality-and-listing eligible buyable rows within 2019-2025
coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.failed_gate_policy: Record the exact Campaign058 factor as terminal and stop before comparison values, daily prices, or forward returns.

uniqueness_after_coverage_only.method: Within each identical quality-listing-candidate-and-comparison-eligible stock-day cross-section, compute pairwise-complete Spearman correlation between directional percentile scores, then take each comparison factor's median daily correlation.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.comparison_order_definition: Take all 80 comparison factors from the bound Campaign057 protocol in exact order, append terminal Campaign057, then append the eight older quality semantic definitions in the exact listed order.
